status_note: First round, run by hand. Web search only: arxiv.org, Semantic Scholar, Hugging Face and alphaXiv could not be fetched, so every paper is recorded from search summaries without reading the full text.
direction: Forgetting, spreading activation and claim time
summary:
Thirteen 2026 papers and three surveys on agent memory consolidation, forgetting, spreading activation and contradiction resolution were found by web search. Independent systems converge on World0's primitives: Hebbian co-activation, spreading activation with decay, and deterministic claim resolution.

Two borrowable mechanisms were tested directly on World0 and refuted: rehearsal on read (from retrieval-driven reconsolidation) and suppressing co-occurrence edges. One change shipped: claims and concept cards now expose their system time (Claim.since_tick / until_tick, ConceptCard.first_seen_tick).

findings.title: Rehearsal on read would not close World0's forgetting gap
findings.discovery: Tested on bigworld: 65 of the 101 forgotten gold endpoints had never been shown in any view, so refreshing what reads show could save about one in ten.
findings.relevance: Retrieval-driven reconsolidation (REALM) is the opposite of World0's pure projection; its rehearsal form fails the probe, so projection stays a pure function.
findings.action: Do not add rehearsal (H-004 refuted, E-004).

findings.title: Hebbian co-activation and spreading activation recur in independent 2026 systems
findings.discovery: HeLa-Mem (Hebbian links, reflective hub condensation) and SYNAPSE (spreading activation with lateral inhibition and decay) lead LoCoMo categories, per search summaries.
findings.relevance: Independent support for World0's activation primitives; lateral inhibition lives in World0's projection (MMR redundancy), not in activation.
findings.action: No change; hub condensation deferred (leans toward summary storage).

findings.title: Claims need a visible time dimension
findings.discovery: TOKI (bitemporal write-time contradiction resolution) and RoMem (phase-rotated superseded facts) both make claim time explicit.
findings.relevance: World0 recorded when a claim was stated and withdrawn but did not expose it; an Agent could not tell until when a withdrawn claim held.
findings.action: Shipped: Claim.since_tick / until_tick and ConceptCard.first_seen_tick (system time, optional fields).

deep_note: No full-text deep analysis in this round: no paper could be fetched. Instead, the two most borrowable mechanisms were tested directly on World0 (E-004, E-005).

insights.label: SPECULATIVE
insights.note: Nothing this round bears on ontology evolution directly; TOKI's bitemporal resolution concerns claim time, not structure.

insights.label: EXPERIMENTAL
insights.note: HeLa-Mem condenses dense hubs into summaries offline, analogous to World0's reflect communities; not adopted because it leans toward summary storage.

insights.label: SUPPORTED
insights.note: HeLa-Mem and SYNAPSE independently use World0's activation primitives; deterministic version-aware aggregation beating LLM conflict resolution (arXiv:2606.01435) supports explicit claim identity plus withdrawal.

recommendations: Keep projection a pure function: do not add rehearsal on read (H-004 refuted).
Keep the co-occurrence edge weight: suppressing it trades closure for precision (H-005 refuted).
Expose claim system time in the API: shipped as optional fields, wire format world0/1 unchanged.
Defer hub-to-summary condensation (HeLa-Mem): it leans toward summary storage and needs a design discussion first.
knowledge_updates: world0.api: Claim.since_tick / Claim.until_tick and ConceptCard.first_seen_tick added (system time: when World0 was told, not when the fact held); commit fb34c5d on dev.
No dynamics change, so LongRun was not re-run; tests 1 598 passed, 10 skipped; every proposition in docs/paper/verify.py verified.
Research protocol docs/research/README.md and the brief page docs/research/brief.html added on dev.
open_questions: What gold rule should define a silently outdated claim: the latest statement for the same (source, relation)?
Should World0 ever carry valid time, or stay with system time only?
What would it cost to evaluate World0 on LoCoMo / LongMemEval with real extraction and a real reader?
priorities: Design the roadmap-0.4 'silently outdated information' evaluation scenario following From Recall to Forgetting (arXiv:2604.20006).
Estimate the cost and changes needed to run World0 on LoCoMo / LongMemEval.
Performance: colour-field diffusion dirties about 17 records per event; consider deferring sub-1e-3 domain-profile changes to reflect.
Read the full texts of 2604.20006, 2609.16053 and 2604.16839 when fetching becomes possible.
